provenance.description: All 24 frozen confirmation fits; retained separately from browser data so every reported confirmation metric can be replayed.
provenance.parameterLayout: Flattened hidden weights (width,2), hidden biases (width), output weights (width), output bias (1); inputs are standardized using the recorded mean and scale.
provenance.training: Joint Adam on binary cross-entropy, float32 CPU; three datasets times four starts in 12 independent blocks using torch.bmm and elementwise output multiplication followed by sum. 12,000 updates: lr.01 through step9000, lr.001 thereafter; no explicit penalty.
provenance.selection: Lowest final training BCE among the four starts, before evaluating the independent test draw. The same four initialization arrays are reused across the three datasets.
provenance.reproduction: --check replays all metrics directly from these frozen parameters without retraining. --refit --refit-confirmation repeats the original batched protocol but floating-point/library changes can produce numerically different fits; byte-for-byte retraining is not promised.
